extraction_notes: P-channel voltages and currents are recorded as positive magnitudes in specs and curve coordinates; original negative signs are preserved in axis and test-condition descriptions.
Transfer, output, and capacitance traces were manually read from typical plotted curves on p. 3 Figs. 1, 2, and 5 at selected axis positions; no points were inferred from absent curves.

Fig. 2 horizontal axis is printed as '-VDS-GATE VOLTAGE'; because the plot is titled Transfer Characteristics, it is interpreted as gate-source voltage magnitude (-VGS), and the drain-source bias is not stated.

The dynamic table publishes Ciss = 405 pF, Coss = 75 pF, and Crss = 55 pF at VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; Fig. 5 traces are separately retained as digitized typical curves and appear at higher capacitance values than the table.
The table publishes typical RDS(on) values of 90 mOhm at VGS = -4.5 V and ID = -2.8 A, and 110 mOhm at VGS = -2.5 V and ID = -2.0 A; corresponding maximum values are 112 mOhm and 142 mOhm.

The switching table publishes Qg = 5.5 nC at VGS = -4.5 V, VDS = -10 V, ID = -2.3 A; a second Qg = 3.3 nC at VGS = -2.5 V, VDS = -10 V, ID = -2.3 A; Qgs = 0.7 nC; Qgd = 1.3 nC; and trr = 13.1 ns at IF = -2.3 A and di/dt = 100 A/us. These fields have no dedicated schema properties.

The static table publishes IDSS maximum 1.0 uA at VDS = -20 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS maximum +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-8 V and VDS = 0 V, and VSD maximum 1.2 V at IS = -0.70 A and VGS = 0 V. These fields have no dedicated schema properties.

The thermal table publishes RthetaJA maximum 312 degC/W and no RthetaJC. Fig. 4, Fig. 7, Fig. 8, and package figures were examined but are not included as model-fitting curves because the strict schema has no dedicated fields for temperature-dependent resistance, SOA, or thermal curves.
